title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist – Web Designer & Developer
description:
Senior Digital Marketing Specialist – Web Designer \& Developer

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 3–8 Years

Job Description

We are looking for a hands\-on **Senior Digital Marketing Specialist – Web Designer \& Developer** to manage digital marketing, website design and development, SEO, content, social media, and analytics.

Key Responsibilities

* Execute SEO, SEM, PPC, social media, email, and lead\-generation campaigns.
* Design, develop, maintain, and optimize responsive websites and landing pages.
* Manage CMS platforms, preferably Webflow.
* Implement **SEO, AEO, and GEO** strategies.
* Create website content, blogs, landing pages, and marketing materials.
* Monitor website and campaign performance using Google Analytics.
* Create digital creatives using Canva, Figma, or Adobe.
* Support marketing automation, email campaigns, and lead management.
* Improve website performance, UX, SEO, and conversion rates.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, Web Development, or related field.
* **5–8 years of experience** in Digital Marketing, Web Design, and Web Development.
* Strong knowledge of SEO, SEM, PPC, social media, and email marketing.
* Proficiency in **HTML, CSS, and JavaScript**.
* Experience with **Webflow or other CMS platforms**.
* Knowledge of Google Analytics and digital marketing tools.
* Experience with Canva, Figma, Adobe, or similar design tools.
* Strong communication, analytical, creative, and problem\-solving skills.

Preferred

Candidates with a portfolio showcasing **website development, digital marketing campaigns, SEO results, landing pages, UI/UX, and creative work** are preferred.

**To Apply:** Submit your updated CV along with your portfolio or relevant work samples.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in Digital marketing?
* How many years of experience do you have in website designing and website developing?
* What is your current salary package and your expected salary?
* Where is your current location? Are you an immediate joiner?

Work Location: In person

title: Designer, Development - IIoT(Adv+Elite)-Husky (India) Guindy,Chennai
description:
At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.



Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state\-of\-the\-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.



Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!


**Job Description**



Develop IIoT systems and ensure seamless integration and functionality within the Advantage\+Elite monitoring platform. Oversee the installation of prototype IoT devices and networks in industrial environments, ensuring system compatibility, stable connectivity, and efficient data collection and processing.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and implement IIoT devices and systems with integrated software and network interfaces.


* Create and maintain secure, reliable IIoT architectures that ensure consistent data flow between devices and cloud platforms.


* Collaborate with cross functional teams (product managers, hardware engineers, data scientists) to define system requirements and deliver complete IIoT solutions.


* Conduct research and development to evaluate emerging IoT technologies, platforms, and methodologies for potential implementation.


* Test, validate, and troubleshoot IIoT systems to ensure stability, efficiency, and security.


* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations related to data privacy, cybersecurity, and IoT device interoperability.


* Provide technical documentation including architecture diagrams, user guides, and system specifications.


* Monitor the performance of deployed IIoT systems and implement updates or upgrades to hardware and software components.


* Stay current with trends and advancements in IoT, cloud, and edge technologies to drive innovation.


**Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience


* 3\+ years of experience in a related industry.


* Strong understanding of Azure services and cloud architecture, including their use cases and deployment patterns.


* Proficiency in programming languages such as C\#, .NET, Java, Node.js, or Python, plus scripting tools like Azure CLI or PowerShell.


* Knowledge of Azure security and identity management, including RBAC and Azure Active Directory.


* Experience with data management and analytics tools such as Azure Data Factory, Kusto, or Azure Synapse Analytics.


* Familiarity with microservices architectures and containerization technologies such as Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

  

  



Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.
